scope: Diagnostic XNU entry probe with BCM-only MMIO suppressed and early exception display; no device action
success_requires: PROBE17: power-key Enter starts XNU; capture original left tiles, A-fields, and right grid x832..1295/y256..759. Blue grid cell=call edge reached; green=continuation reached. Decode IDs using bound dense_bootstrap.edges. Unlit cells do not prove the kernel stopped there.

kernel_source.source: hash-pinned early-security prelink plus bounded native entry diagnostic patches

adt_detail.stdout: nuwa ADT: 13120 bytes, dram 0x240000000 @ 0x8c0000000, 8 cpu(s), timebase 19200000 Hz
adt_detail.note: no RAMDisk/TrustCache/GpuAddon placeholder, so the loader takes the no-sidecar path in DarwinBoot.c:561-567

entry.title: XNU ENTRY PROBE 17 - DENSE BOOTSTRAP CALL AND RETURN

expected_screen_outcomes: PROBE17: power-key Enter starts XNU; capture original left tiles, A-fields, and right grid x832..1295/y256..759. Blue grid cell=call edge reached; green=continuation reached. Decode IDs using bound dense_bootstrap.edges. Unlit cells do not prove the kernel stopped there.
Any later XNU text or panic requires separate attribution; no band proves MMU enabled or iOS started
recovery: the original stock boot is preserved as the image header; after the trial the stock boot is loaded back and Android must report boot_completed=1 with the same boot_a/vendor_boot_a/init_boot_a digests
not_proven: Real nuwa execution of this candidate
Full donor/native ABI or iOS boot

limitations: No output is guaranteed after pmap removes the diagnostic framebuffer mapping
TPIDR_EL1 shim is an intentional behaviour change, distinct from transparent hooks
Stage tiles and field IDs must be read using this revision layout

dense_bootstrap.semantics: call means before native BL; continuation means the native post-call address executed, possibly from another predecessor; each site drawn once
limitations: Later kernel framebuffer writes may overwrite the panel
No event ordering or call count is inferred from the cumulative grid
